cards.def:
The study of interactions between countries.
हिंदी: अंतर्राष्ट्रीय संबंध
examples: International Relations studies diplomacy and conflict.
International Relations affects trade and security.

cards.def:
The art and skill of managing public affairs and conducting foreign diplomacy wisely.
हिंदी: राजकौशल / राज्य-संचालन की कला
examples: Skillful statecraft allowed the small nation to navigate between competing superpowers.
History remembers the peace treaty as a masterpiece of international statecraft.
Modern statecraft requires a deep synthesis of economic leverage and military deterrence.
Patience and nuanced communication are indispensable qualities of prudent statecraft.

cards.def:
A country's strategy toward other nations.
हिंदी: विदेश नीति
examples: Foreign Policy responds to global events.

cards.def:
The foundational principle that all independent states enjoy identical legal standing under international law.
हिंदी: संप्रभु समानता
examples: The United Nations Charter is explicitly founded on the principle of sovereign equality.
Sovereign equality guarantees small island nations a voice equal to large global powers.
Disputes over veto privileges frequently challenge the theoretical norm of sovereign equality.
International law upholds sovereign equality regardless of a state's economic size.

cards.def:
A country's goals and priorities.
हिंदी: राष्ट्रीय हित
examples: National Interest must be defined clearly.
National Interest can conflict with ethics.

cards.def:
The influence of geography on politics and power.
हिंदी: भू-राजनीति

A ban on trade with a country.
हिंदी: व्यापारिक नाकाबंदी

Influence through attraction and culture.
हिंदी: सॉफ्ट पावर / सांस्कृतिक प्रभाव

Influence through military and economic strength.
हिंदी: हार्ड पावर / सैन्य व आर्थिक ताकत
examples: Hard Power must be used wisely.

cards.def:
Dominance of one power over others.
हिंदी: वर्चस्व

Distribution of power preventing dominance.
हिंदी: शक्ति-संतुलन
examples: Balance of Power shifts over time.

cards.def:
Acting alone without allies.
हिंदी: एकपक्षवाद

Cooperation among multiple nations.
हिंदी: बहुपक्षवाद

A global organization promoting peace and cooperation.
हिंदी: संयुक्त राष्ट्र

The UN body responsible for peace and security.
हिंदी: सुरक्षा परिषद
examples: Security Council has five permanent members.

cards.def:
Maintaining peace in conflict zones.
हिंदी: शांति-स्थापना

Assistance to people in crisis.
हिंदी: मानवीय सहायता

Mass displacement of people across borders.
हिंदी: शरणार्थी संकट

Use of violence for political aims.
हिंदी: आतंकवाद

Extreme political or religious views.
हिंदी: उग्रवाद / अतिवाद

A rebellion against authority.
हिंदी: विद्रोह / बग़ावत

Conflict where powers support opposing sides.
हिंदी: छद्म युद्ध

Competition to build military strength.
हिंदी: हथियारों की होड़

Reduction of military weapons.
हिंदी: निरस्त्रीकरण

The spread of nuclear weapons.
हिंदी: परमाणु प्रसार

Preventing the spread of nuclear weapons.
हिंदी: अप्रसार

Preventing attack through threat of retaliation.
हिंदी: प्रतिरोध / डराकर रोकने की नीति

Economic conflict through tariffs.
हिंदी: व्यापार युद्ध

Cooperative agreements and alliances entered into by a specific subset of countries on targeted issues.
हिंदी: बहुपक्षीय (चुनिंदा देशों का) समूह-समझौता
examples: Frustrated by global gridlock, like-minded nations pivoted toward plurilateralism.
The digital trade pact was negotiated through innovative plurilateralism.
Plurilateralism allows motivated countries to advance standards without waiting for unanimous consensus.
Critics worry that selective plurilateralism might undermine broader universal treaties.

cards.def:
Cooperation among countries in a region.
हिंदी: क्षेत्रवाद

Conflict over territorial control.
हिंदी: संप्रभुता विवाद
examples: Sovereignty Disputes must be resolved peacefully.

cards.def:
A nation's right to its borders.
हिंदी: क्षेत्रीय अखंडता
examples: Territorial Integrity is a core principle.

cards.def:
The right of people to choose their governance.
हिंदी: आत्म-निर्णय

A political policy advocating the restoration of historical territory or populations belonging to a nation.
हिंदी: अधूरी भूमि-दावेदारी की नीति
examples: Aggressive irredentism has historically served as a pretext for territorial invasions.
Border tensions reignited when regional leaders embraced populist irredentism.
International treaties seek to neutralize irredentism by affirming inviolable borders.
Fanning the flames of ethnic irredentism destabilized the delicate regional ceasefire.

cards.def:
Indirect control of former colonies.
हिंदी: नव-उपनिवेशवाद

Developing countries in Africa, Asia, Latin America.
हिंदी: वैश्विक दक्षिण

Developed countries mainly in Europe and North America.
हिंदी: वैश्विक उत्तर

A nation with lower economic development.
हिंदी: विकासशील देश

A nation with high economic development.
हिंदी: विकसित देश
examples: Developed Countries must lead on climate.

cards.def:
Assistance from one country to another.
हिंदी: विदेशी सहायता

Using loans to gain influence.
हिंदी: क़र्ज़ कूटनीति

Using culture to build international goodwill.
हिंदी: सांस्कृतिक कूटनीति

Informal dialogue between non-officials.
हिंदी: ट्रैक-टू कूटनीति / अनौपचारिक संवाद
examples: Track II Diplomacy complements official talks.
Track II Diplomacy must be discreet.

cards.def:
Managing global issues through cooperation.
हिंदी: वैश्विक शासन
